# Sparsity_Degradation_Threshold

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The specific sparsity level at which further reduction in spike activity causes a sharp, non-linear drop in network accuracy or task performance. Identifies the operational limit for sparse coding in TCC and iNEST, informing where to stop pruning or activity suppression.
